q: The Maslov index of a Lagrangian path (path in the Lagrangian Grassmannian Λ(n)) is an integer that counts signed intersections with the Maslov cycle. In physics and semiclassical analysis, it appears in the:
opts: WKB quantisation condition: ∮ p dq = (n + μ/4)h where μ is the Maslov index
exp: The Maslov index μ appears in the semiclassical (WKB/Bohr-Sommerfeld) quantisation condition ∮ p dq = (n + μ/4)h, correcting the naive quantisation by counting caustic crossings. It is a topological invariant of Lagrangian submanifolds.
